how_to_apply: STPI Apprentice Trainee Apply Online process requires mandatory prior registration on the NATS Portal, followed by application through STPI's own web portal. Only online applications will be accepted; offline applications are not considered.
Register on the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) Portal at https://nats.education.gov.in before applying through STPI's portal - this is mandatory.
On the NATS Portal, click the "Student" section, then "Enroll" under the Student section, confirm you meet the eligibility criteria, and proceed to the Enrollment Form.
Fill in personal information: name, date of birth, gender, email, mobile number, and create a login ID and password. Enter your Aadhaar number and other required identification details.
Fill in educational details: highest qualification (Diploma/Graduate), institution name, year of passing, and percentage/CGPA.
Fill in communication and bank details: present and permanent address, and bank account details (account number, IFSC code, bank name) for stipend processing.
Review all details carefully and submit the NATS registration form; a unique Student Enrolment ID will be generated and sent to your registered email ID.
Visit STPI's Web Portal under the Career Section at www.stpi.in and fill the online application for Apprentice Trainee, mentioning your NATS Enrolment ID in STPI's Online application module.
Submit the completed application on or before 30.09.2026; applications received after the last date will not be considered.
important_instructions: Only online applications will be accepted through STPI's Web Portal (www.stpi.in, under Career Section). Candidates who have already completed their apprenticeship (if any) in the past at STPI or any other organization shall not be considered. The stipend payable to apprentices will be facilitated through the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mechanism via the NATS portal, after successful registration for DBT.

faq.question: Q1. What is STPI Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a notification (Advt. No. 7(1)/I/STPI-HQ/2026-27 dated 14.09.2026) issued by Software Technology Parks of India (STPI) for engagement of Apprentice Trainees under the Apprenticeship Act-1961, for a period of one year, offering 15 vacancies across 10 STPI centres.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in STPI Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 15 vacancies are available across STPI centres: HQ (2), Bengaluru (2), Bhubaneswar (2), Chennai (1), Guwahati (1), Gurugram (1), Hyderabad (2), Noida (2), Mohali (1), and Pune (1).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for STPI Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application must be submitted on or before 30.09.2026. Applications received after this date will not be considered.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for STPI Apprentice Trainee?
faq.answer: Candidates need either a B.Tech/B.E in Electronics/Electrical/Electronics & Communications/Telecommunications/Computer Science/Information Technology, or a Bachelor's degree in Arts/Commerce/Administration, etc., completed in June 2021 or thereafter.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for STPI Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years. The maximum age, as on 14.09.2026, is 27 years for Unreserved candidates, 30 years for OBC candidates, and 32 years for SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the stipend for STPI Apprentice Trainee 2026?
faq.answer: B.E/B.Tech candidates receive Rs. 15,000/- per month, while Bachelor in Arts/Commerce/Administration candidates receive Rs. 12,300/- per month. The Screening-cum-Selection Committee may offer a higher stipend, up to Rs. 20,000/- per month, based on interview performance.

faq.question: Q7. Is NATS Portal registration mandatory for STPI Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes, it is mandatory for candidates to register on the NATS Portal (https://nats.education.gov.in) before applying for the apprenticeship through STPI's Portal, and to mention the NATS Enrolment ID in the STPI online application.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply online for STPI Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must first register on the NATS Portal, then apply through STPI's Web Portal (www.stpi.in, under Career Section), mentioning their NATS Enrolment ID, on or before 30.09.2026.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for STPI Apprentice Trainee?
faq.answer: Selection is carried out by shortlisting candidates based on their performance in the interview, depending on the vacancies available in the various disciplines. Reservation applies as per Government of India Rules.
